name: Type Trail
description: A typographic trail effect that leaves a motion blur behind animated text. Perfect for kinetic typography and high-energy motion graphics.

name: Video Title Slide
description: A clean animated title slide template for video openers. Great for YouTube intros and presentation title cards.

name: Wow: Rotate and Scale
description: An animation template that combines rotation and scaling for a strong entrance effect. Good for hero elements and title reveals where the first impression needs to do some work.

name: Zero Gravity: Bouncy Words
description: A text animation template from Rico where words float and bounce with a weightless physical feel. Great for playful title cards and social content where you want the type itself to be entertaining.

name: Gradient Background Loop
description: A procedural gradient background animated through smooth color transitions. Ideal for looping backgrounds and branded motion graphics.

name: Gradients: Perspective Tunnel
description: A gradient tunnel template with a deep vanishing point that creates a sense of traveling through color. Perfect for atmospheric backgrounds and ambient loop sequences.

name: Kaleidoscope: Intro Slide
description: A kaleidoscope pattern template that unfolds into an intro slide. Good for vibrant openers and title sequences where the reveal should feel like an event.

name: Morph: Animated Face
description: A face animation template that morphs between different expressions. Good for character animation and expressive brand mascot content.

name: Morph: Animated Icon
description: An icon animation template where an icon morphs fluidly from one form into another. Good for UI demonstrations and icon system showcases.

name: Morph: Line to Radar Chart
description: A morphing animation template that transitions from a simple line into a full radar chart. Good for data visualization presentations where you want the chart to feel earned rather than just appearing.

name: Morph: Running Character
description: An animation template where an illustrated character morphs through a running loop. Good for fitness app mascots and playful brand character animations.

name: Morph: Video Mask
description: A template where video is revealed through a shape that morphs as it opens. Works for cinematic openers and creative video transitions.

name: Morph: Weather Icons
description: A template where weather icons morph smoothly between states. Good for weather app UI demos and forecast feature showcases.
